In accordance with NASA’s Environmentally Responsible Aviation (ERA) project goals, the configuration was intended for entry into service by 2025

The ERA project has a goal of simultaneously reducing noise (42db cumulative below the Stage 4 certification level), fuel burn (50% reduction compared to currently operating aircraft), and emissions (75% reduction in nitrogen oxide compared to the current standard)
